notes.title: Good Kill! Early Access - V5 - New Features, Bug Fixes & Enhancements
notes.content:
Attention, Gunners!
Get ready for another huge update! The battlefield just got better with fixes, new features, and exciting additions. Thanks to your continued feedback, we’re pushing the limits of what's possible. Here's what’s new in Version 5 for the Steam Winter Sale!

New Additions & Enhancements


Level Updates:

 Level 01: Foliage edited for better visuals.
 Level 02 - Stage 2: Fixed enemy reinforcement vehicles colliding, and vehicle road edits made to improve gameplay.
 Level 03: AI spawn issues fixed, AI spawners and kill zones edited, foliage adjustments for improved coverage.
 Level 06: Fixed RPG spawn issue before quest, rock AI cover fixed, and collision improvements in kill zones and spawn points.
 Level 07: Fixed AI nav mesh walking on water.
 Level 09 & 10: Various AI, foliage, and nav mesh adjustments for smoother gameplay.


Helicopter Updates:

 Cayuse Box Shadows: Disabled for performance improvements.
 Tutorial Helicopter: Fixed main and tail rotor functionality, and sprint state issue after entering the helicopter.


Gameplay Updates:

 Muffled Sound Fix: Fixed the remaining muffled sound effect when health is low.
 Tutorial Outro: Shortened for better pacing.
 M60 Sprint to Aim Bug: Fixed visual bug during transition.
 Gunner Sense: Range increased for better battlefield awareness.


New Features:

 Secondary Weapon Added: The M79 grenade launcher is now available and selectable!
 Footstep Sounds: Realistic footstep sounds for different surfaces (wood, metal, sand, soil).


New Level Props:

 US Dock: Added to the US Airbase for more immersive environments.



Last Stand Maps Update:

 New last stand map added.


Other Updates:

 Weapon Sway: Adjusted for better aiming control.
 DSHK & M60D Sounds: Reworked for improved audio fidelity.
 Sidearm Added: The Colt 1911 is now available to use by pressing 3.
 Head Bobbing Toggle: Added an option in the controls menu to toggle head bobbing during movement.


Bug Fixes:

 AI Issues: Fixed AI stuck inside vehicles and collision issues with various objects.
 Helicopter Rotation: Fixed the bug where the helicopter would spin on its own.
 DSHK Bullet Traces: Tracers now more visible.


With every update, Good Kill evolves into the ultimate battlefield experience. Your feedback is the backbone of Early Access, and we can’t thank you enough for your support.

Stay sharp, soldiers. The mission continues.

notes.title: Good Kill! Early Access - V4 - Get Ready for New Features and Fixes!
notes.content:
Attention, Gunners!

We’re thrilled to deliver another impactful update for Good Kill! With your invaluable feedback, we’ve added game-changing features, polished existing systems, and resolved bugs to enhance your battlefield experience. Here's what’s new in Version 4:

New Additions & Enhancements

 Auto Reload: Weapons now reload automatically when ammo runs out—stay in the action!
 Invert Mouse Option: For our left-handed players and those who prefer an alternate control scheme, we’ve added the option to invert mouse movement for a more comfortable gameplay experience.
 Explosive Reactions: Allies and enemies now react dramatically to explosions, watch them fly!

Bug Fixes & Adjustments
[olist]
 Weapon Fixes:

  First reload issues for M14 and M60 resolved.
  Overheat UI bug fixed when swapping doorguns.

 Level Reworks:

  Enemy spawns, explosive actors, and cover locations adjusted in Levels 03–10 for better pacing and strategy.
 Fixed Level 07's empty Gaz66 issue.
 Level 01 Gaz66 Movement Problem: Fixed movement issues to improve gameplay.

 Helicopter Hover Improvements: Smoother controls with capped drift distances.
 Cinematic Audio Fix: Background and minigun sounds no longer persist during cutscenes.
 Persistent Health Bug: Low-health audio issues when starting a new level resolved.
 M16 Grenade Effect: Reduced the effect radius for better balance.
[/olist]
Polished Gameplay & Visuals

 M14 FOV Adjustments: Improved aiming clarity.
 UI Overhaul: Tooltips and button sounds in level completion scenes revamped.
 Explosive Actor Enhancements: Levels 02, 08, and 09 updated for balanced challenges.

New Sounds

 Added audio cues for the Seek Target ability, medkit use, and hero damage or death.
 Helicopter pilot sounds now pause correctly with the game.


With every update, Good Kill evolves into the ultimate battlefield experience. Your feedback is the backbone of Early Access, and we can’t thank you enough for your support.

Stay sharp, soldiers. The mission continues.

 Its high-volume fire capability made it a key asset for both close air support and area denial, demonstrating unparalleled effectiveness in intense combat environments.

notes.title: Community Update #1 Napalm & Artillery
notes.content:
Hey GI's,

We are excited to bring the immersive world of Vietnam War to you with Good Kill! We are committed to create rich experience absorbing you.

In the meantime, we are experimenting different explosions that will blow your mind - Artillery and Napalm!

Artillery Support
Artillery refers to large-calibre firearms designed primarily to deliver munitions over long distances. These weapons are an integral part of modern warfare due to their ability to provide indirect fire support, which means that they can hit targets that are beyond the line of sight, such as enemy positions, fortifications or vehicles.
[previewyoutube=JfkcLItr-BY;full][/previewyoutube]

Napalm
Napalm is a flammable liquid that sticks to surfaces upon impact and burns intensely. They're used to set buildings, woods and enemy forces ablaze, creating havoc and denying access to an area. Its ability to generate intense heat and spread rapidly makes it a devastating weapon, often used to disrupt enemy operations and infrastructure.
[previewyoutube=Goe5jz8hj8k;full][/previewyoutube]

Wait for more!
We will bring more "devastating" content to you. Follow us to stay updated!
